text:
harper: Heads-up — two big reasons to celebrate this week! Nina just accepted Senior PM 🎉 and Jamal welcomed a baby boy (Milo) yesterday 👶💙. Thinking cake in the common area Friday at 3pm. Who's in?
nate: Hoooooorray!!! Congrats Nina & Jamal :tada: :heart:
dina: OMG congrats both!! Milo is adorable — send pics pls :smile:
luke: 3pm works for me. Do we have cake flavor democracy or imma bring donuts to sway votes? :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
anjali: Vote time — react with :cake: for chocolate, :lemon: for lemon, :birthday: for funfetti, :green_apple: for vegan vanilla. Also any allergies?
bryce: Chocolate + coffee for me. Also can we get a tiny congratulations sign for Nina? A bit of confetti?
harper: Love the sign idea. @people-ops-bot can we get a small printed sign and a card for signatures?
people-ops-bot: people-ops noted — will order a 4x6 printed card and sign stand. Please confirm names to include.
dina: Card should say: "Congrats Nina — Senior PM" and "Welcome Milo (Jamal & Noor)"
luke: Can we do a joint photo op at 3:05 for social? I can snap and post to #general.
anjali: Quick dietary note: Noor requested dairy-free options. So can we get at least one vegan/DF cake?
bryce: I'll coordinate with @catering-coordinator — sending options now.
catering-coordinator: Hi team — we can do: 1) Chocolate fudge (contains dairy), 2) Vegan vanilla with dairy-free frosting, 3) Lemon curd (contains dairy), 4) Funfetti (can be made DF on request). Pricing for two-tier (feeds ~25) is $65. Delivery Friday 2:45pm.
harper: Thanks! Let's do Chocolate + Vegan vanilla. Confirmed.
nate: RSVP: me, harper, dina, luke, anjali, bryce. Also can I bring balloons?
people-ops-bot: Calendar invite created: Office Celebration — Fri 3:00 PM (Organizer: harper). Event link: https://calendar.example.com/event/0xabc
anjali: I'll add a short note to product channel announcing Nina's promotion — want me to include a short blurb about her new scope?
harper: Please do! Suggested blurb: "Huge congrats to Nina on becoming Senior PM — she led the recent rollout of the routing policy features and will be taking ownership of infra integrations. Well deserved 🎉"
dina: Awwww. Also Jamal said he and Noor are grateful but keeping things low-key — small celebration works perfect.
luke: Pro tip: put the card on the table near cake and pass the phone around for signatures.
bryce: I'll bring confetti poppers (biodegradable!). Someone remind me to keep them outside the office door for cleanup.
harper: Perfect. Thanks everyone. If you want to add to the card, drop by my desk before 2:50pm on Friday.
nate: Pics or it didn't happen :camera_with_flash:
dina: Photo permissions from Jamal? He's cool w/ photos but prefers not to post baby pics publicly — only internal.
luke: noted. I'll post only office pics (no baby closeups).
anjali: Posting in #general at 4pm with the promotion blurb and a group photo.
people-ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: 1) Order confirmed with catering. 2) Card printed. 3) Invite sent.
harper: Alright team — party planning mission accomplished. Big congrats again to Nina & Jamal! :party_parrot:
